description: Get the tonal distribution of articles matching a query as a histogram (bins approximately -30 to +30). Unlike a single average tone score, the histogram reveals whether coverage is uniformly negative, bimodal (some articles extremely positive and some extremely negative), or clustered near neutral. Each bin carries its first 3 representative article links and referenceCount, how many GDELT returned; name bins in the bins input to get only those bins, each with every link. A response carries as many whole bins as fit its size budget; when more remain it returns nextOffset — pass it back as offset with otherwise identical inputs for the next page. Distinct from gdelt_get_coverage_timeline (mode: tone) — this is a snapshot distribution across all matching articles, not a time series. Use gdelt_get_coverage_timeline with mode "tone" to see how sentiment shifted over time.

bins.description: Tone bins to return alone, e.g. [-7, 4]. Take them from histogram[].bin in a prior response, or from the list an unknown_bin error prints. The response then carries only these bins, in histogram order, each with every representative article link instead of the first 3. A value matching no bin is rejected rather than silently ignored.

endDatetime.description: End datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20240131235959). Must pair with startDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected.

offset.description: Zero-based bin offset — into the histogram, or into the bins named in bins. Pass nextOffset from the preceding response, with otherwise identical inputs, to get the next page.

query.description: Search query using GDELT syntax. Same operators as gdelt_search_articles: phrases, boolean OR, sourcecountry:, sourcelang:, domain:, theme: (GKG theme identifiers come from gdelt_search_themes).

startDatetime.description: Start datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20240101000000). Must pair with endDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected.

timespan.description: Time window relative to now, minimum "15min"; other examples: "24h", "7d", "1m". Ignored when startDatetime/endDatetime are set. Maximum 3 months.

name: gdelt_get_tone_distribution

effectiveQuery.description: Echoed query string for use in follow-up calls.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_bin`: A value passed in the bins input matches no bin in a non-empty histogram. `offset_out_of_range`: The requested offset is at or beyond the last bin of a non-empty histogram, or of the bins named in bins. `invalid_date_range`: Only one of startDatetime / endDatetime was supplied, one of them is not a real UTC calendar timestamp, or startDatetime is not earlier than endDatetime. `invalid_query`: GDELT rejected the query string as malformed — bad keyword length, unbalanced parentheses, or an illegal character. `gdelt_rate_limited`: GDELT rejected the request for its one-request-per-five-seconds limit, or too many requests were already queued for this one to start in time. `gdelt_unavailable`: GDELT DOC API is unreachable or temporarily returned no usable data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

histogram.description: The bins of this page, sorted from most negative to most positive — the whole histogram when it fits.

items.description: A single tone histogram bin with article count and representative articles.

articles.description: Representative articles in this tone bin — the first 3, or all of them for a bin named in bins.

items.description: A representative article for this tone bin.

bin.description: Tone bin integer (typically -30 to +30; 0 is neutral).

count.description: Number of articles in this bin.

referenceCount.description: How many representative articles GDELT returned for this bin; articles carries the first 3 unless the bin was named in bins.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page, for the same inputs. Absent when this page reaches the last bin.

notice.description: Guidance when no articles matched in the window — how to broaden the query or extend the window — or, when this response is one page of several, which bins it returned out of how many. Absent when the whole histogram fit in one response.

summary.description: Summary statistics derived from the whole histogram, not this page. Each value is omitted when the histogram cannot support it — all of them on an empty result.

neutralPct.description: Percentage of articles in the near-neutral range (bins -2 to +2). Omitted when the histogram counts no articles.

peakNegativeBin.description: Tone bin with the highest count among negative bins (bin < 0). Omitted when no negative bin was returned.

peakPositiveBin.description: Tone bin with the highest count among positive bins (bin > 0). Omitted when no positive bin was returned.

totalCount.description: Total number of articles across all histogram bins, not only this page.

title: Get GDELT Tone Distribution
